item.stem:
Meena wants to separate a mixture of fine sand and small pebbles using a sieve in her kitchen.

For sieving to work, the holes in the sieve must let the smaller particles pass through while the bigger particles stay on the sieve.

Which row correctly describes when sieving is suitable?

options.A: particles have different sizes: sieving works; particles have the same size: sieving does not work
options.B: particles have different sizes: sieving does not work; particles have the same size: sieving works
options.C: particles have different sizes: sieving works; particles have the same size: sieving works
options.D: particles have different sizes: sieving does not work; particles have the same size: sieving does not work
